mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level is associated with increased discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The relationship is continuous and active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS against 20-day forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the direction of the relationship reverses (positive IC) in more than 40% of the sample.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals a weakening labor market, which is associated with reduced consumer spending and lower corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) from their prior month values indicates a weakening consumer demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases (i.e., 20-day returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances), or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and INDPRO decline from prior month
failure_condition: The mechanism fails when INDPRO decline in the late-cycle regime does not produce negative returns in at least 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) is associated with stronger consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The relationship is continuous and active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for RSAFS against 20-day forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the direction of the relationship reverses (negative IC) in more than 40% of the sample.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.8%) signals strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 3.8% fails to predict positive returns in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (the 2017 index base) signals a contraction in manufacturing activity, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for INDPRO is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
